source_text: Scribe hoc monimentum in libro. Memoria victoriae contra Amalech. Dominus bellum habet cum Amalech a generatione.
pass_a_gloss: Write this memorial in book. Memory of-victory against Amalek. Lord war has with Amalek from generation.
pass_b_english: [[Write this as a memorial in a book >> Bible:Exodus 17:14]]. Remember victory over Amalek. [[The Lord has war with Amalek from generation to generation >> Bible:Exodus 17:16]].
